controlling_scope: Finite tool/library membership and operational deep stress. This is not an every-repository-surface run.

authority.controlling_user_correction: Deep stress each tool/library; use representative sims as consumers; Ratchet/QIT proof status is orthogonal.

bucket_policy.current_core: must receive full deep ladder and edge coverage
bucket_policy.current_support: must receive full operational ladder but cannot count as an independent scientific engine
bucket_policy.current_optional_available: must receive full deep ladder; pass does not promote to core
bucket_policy.current_isolated: must run only under exact named project and receive full deep ladder
bucket_policy.admitted_quarantined_surface: only the named admitted surface may pass; full package remains quarantined
bucket_policy.legacy_unclassified: stress for reconciliation, never inherit current membership
bucket_policy.candidate_available_unisolated: inventory only until exact isolated project exists
bucket_policy.blocked_or_avoid: expected absence or incompatibility is a green policy result, not an operational tool pass

claim_ceiling: Operational integration evidence only. No tool row proves the two QIT engines, the Ratchet, a scientific rung, or release eligibility.
